_about: Sir Charles Thomas Newton (1816-1894), Keeper of Greek and Roman Antiquities at the British Museum, excavator of the Mausoleum, raw IA OCR of his Essays on Art and Archaeology (1880) and a paper on two Rhodian inscriptions (1878; Greek-dense, kept under the Greek-facing ruling). Not John Newton, whose shelf is newton.  Greek antiquities (lane B, round dz: sixth IA subject sweep). No uids minted.
